release_notes: Offline local login with First Admin Setup.
Admin and Warehouse User roles for shared warehouse workstations.
Admin-only User Management for adding users, resetting passwords, and enabling or disabling accounts.
Audit Trail viewer and CSV export for login/logout, scans, master data, allocation, output, and Data Folder changes.
Local password hashing with per-user salts; plain-text passwords are never stored.
Manual updater remains full-folder ZIP based and preserves the selected Data Folder.
